metadata.title: Clicked like I’m smashing a vending machine and somehow popped 1 dude? Valorant logic is wild!
metadata.description:
Me: panic clicking like it’s my new dance move
Enemy: probably wondering if I hacked
Valorant just gifted me a kill out of pure chaos
Click if your aim ever throws curveballs!

Tap if your worst clicks ever surprise you!
